definition: a pattern of action passed down over time
description: A traditional Dutch cheese market on a cobbled town square. Two carriers in white uniforms and orange sashes trot past with a wooden barrow stacked high with yellow cheese wheels on their shoulders, watched by a crowd of onlookers. A young carrier picks a heavy wheel off a pile, lifts it up to the camera and grins, then stacks more wheels into tall towers before clapping his hands over the finished piles.
